sentences.text: Chart Number One, published by NOAA and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, explains every symbol and abbreviation on nautical charts, and the exam draws on it.
Green marks areas that cover and uncover with the tide, like mud flats and oyster bars that dry at low water.
Blue tints show shallower water, usually inside a chosen depth contour, and white shows deeper water.
Magenta is used for lights, aids to navigation, cables, and restricted or regulated areas, so it draws your eye to things that matter.
